new: NFQWS2 Manager now provides a complete strategy-intelligence cycle: evidence-aware diagnostics, Strategy Bench and AutoSelect, target memory, scoring/recommendations, a curated upstream/Zapret strategy corpus, and guarded Safe Apply.
The NFQWS workspace integrates an expanded DPI Detector v5 experience with a managed runtime foundation, native console/web diagnostics, live report streaming, and detailed result rendering.
Monitoring now includes a live process manager with CPU/RSS, search, and sorting; the table refreshes without page jumps and keeps all columns compact on a normal desktop.
fixes: Live bench execution is blocked during management SSH sessions; parallel-bench firewall insertion is atomic and command execution uses the shared safety runner.
Processing Map, tcp16 probe/memory, strategy registry, Zapret parsing, and recommendation-planner issues are fixed, with additional maintenance-job hardening.
Process Manager layout is compacted so long process names/commands cannot stretch the table and CPU/RAM/Threads/PPID remain visible without normal horizontal scrolling.
compatibility: Beta 0.10.0-beta.3 keeps the coherent seven-component RouterForge train.
Beta is published for aarch64-3.10, mips-3.4, and mipsel-3.4: 7 components × 3 targets = 21 IPKs.
ARM64 remains the production target; MIPS and MIPSel remain experimental. Stable/main is not promoted by this Beta release.
technical: The Beta train uses 0.10.0~beta.3 for all seven components; the immutable snapshot is routerforge-v0.10.0-beta.3.
Beta.3 consolidates 120 validated dev commits after immutable Beta.2, including the NFQWS intelligence/web-complete workstream and Monitoring Process Manager.
The next active workstream is P23 RouterForge Idle Footprint Reduction: adaptive collectors, polling consolidation, and lower DNS hot-retention.
